question: As per physicists and their major contributions/discoveries, Which of the following pair is INCORRECT?

options.text: Louis Victor de Broglie – Wavenature of matter

solution:
The correct answer is __**Paul Dirac – Liquid helium.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• One of the most influential **physicists** of the 20th century is thought to have been the English theoretical physicist **Paul Adrien Maurice Dirac.**
 
• He was the **1933** **Nobel** **Prize** winner, the Lucasian Professor of Mathematics at the University of Cambridge, and a professor of physics at Florida State University and the University of Miami.
 
• Both **quantum** **mechanics** and **quantum** **electrodynamics** owe their early development in large part to Dirac.
